name.description: The name (user name) of the user signing in. Not required if using a personal access token.

personalAccessTokenName.description: The name of the personal access token. Use this instead of name and password for token-based authentication.

personalAccessTokenSecret.description: The secret value of the personal access token.

contentUrl.description: The URL namespace of the site. For the default site on Tableau Server, use an empty string. For Tableau Cloud, this is the site name in the URL.
